extracted.name: Instant Pot Lentil Tacos
extracted.description: You really wont miss the meat in these flavorful, filling, and healthy Instant Pot Lentil Tacos! Ready in 20 minutes, and easily adaptable to use ingredients and toppings you already have, this vegetarian instant pot recipe is a WINNER.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups dry lentils (, green or brown)
4 cups low-sodium chicken broth ((or vegetable broth))
corn or flour tortillas (, for serving)
instruction_lines: Add all ingredients to instant pot and stir to combine.
Close the lid and move valve to sealing position.
Cook on manual (high pressure) for 15 minutes.
Once the timer beeps, cover the valve with a towel and switch it to quick release to release all of the pressure.
Allow to cool while you prepare toppings.
Serve warm, inside corn or flour tortillas, with desired toppings.
